headline: New Zealand Greens Unveil Fiscal Plan Proposing $8B Wealth and Corporate Tax
summary: The Green Party of New Zealand released its fiscal blueprint, promising to generate $8 billion in annual revenue through taxes on the super-rich and corporations while increasing healthcare outlays by $3 billion yearly.
why: Fiscal platform proposals from major political parties shape future corporate tax policies, government borrowing, and public sector expenditures.

impacts.name: New Zealand Corporate Sector
impacts.why: Higher proposed wealth and corporate taxation would reduce net corporate earnings if enacted.
